note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a key-bag: the datasets-server infers `struct<success: bool>` from the earliest shards, whose 15 records carry only `success`, then cannot cast the 6536 later records that also carry `terminal_only` and `horizon_steps` (plus `mid_reward_steps` on 1063 of them). Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`path`, `command`, `old`, `new`, `pattern`, `contents`, `glob`, `limit`, `offset`)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool) on all 6551 records, `terminal_only` (bool) and `horizon_steps` (int) on 6536, `mid_reward_steps` (int) on 1063; the three observed key sets are 5473 x {success, terminal_only, horizon_steps}, 1063 x {success, terminal_only, horizon_steps, mid_reward_steps}, 15 x {success}

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on all 6551 records, plus `plant` on 939 and `domain` / `shop` on 585

disclosures.summary: Six records are designed leftover-mill phrasing: their goal, steps, and outcome repeat the filler token `leftover` (198 occurrences per record, against at most 25 in any other record). They are `sparse-reward-long-task-factory` episodes stamped with this dataset's own factory and carry the same episode schema as their neighbours, so they are a designed artifact of this factory rather than a foreign dump; they are kept exactly as generated.

This factory is the source, not the host, of the published dest-stamped `srl-*` rows in the frozen leftover-mill census: `srl-r500-networkd-dhcp-ipv4-only-c67a` sits in `observability-debug-trajectories` and `srl-r641`-`srl-r645` sit in `eval-harness-trajectories`, all six stamped `meta.factory = sparse-reward-long-task-factory`. None of them is published here, and every one of this dataset's own 6551 records carries `meta.factory = sparse-reward-long-task-factory` and `meta.generator = grok-4.6`, so there is no factory mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.

disclosures: The `leftover` in this dataset's blurb is its subject matter, so the token alone marks nothing: 5958 of 6551 records mention it somewhere, 32 records beyond the six named above use it in the goal as ordinary leftover-state language (a leftover `_acme-challenge` TXT record, leftover PDFs in `/tmp`, a leftover socket), and 939 records carry `meta.plant = designed`. Only the six records named above are the designed leftover-mill batch.
Every one of the 211140 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
